description: Gaussian splat reconstructed from a smartphone video (COLMAP + Brush).

notes: Scale is estimated from an assumed 1.45 m camera height (room height comes out at 3.82 m).
Source: Eyeful Tower 'apartment' (Meta, VR-NeRF, SIGGRAPH Asia 2023), MIT licence; colmap/images_8, every 3rd rig position.
Uncleaned Brush output: clean_splat.py removed real furniture on this rig capture.
Reconstruction-to-world transform baked into the splat (splat-transform -r/-s/-t), so worldFromReconstruction is identity.
